title: Michael's regression: three creatures in front of the truck
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Three creatures I never seen out of this whole world was in front of me.

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran, says that at the November 5 missile site near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977, three creatures stood in front of his truck. He tells Michels the memory came back in a regression, a hypnosis session meant to recover buried memories, which he links to Yvonne Smith, and he says, "Three creatures I never seen out of this whole world was in front of me." If true, beings confronted an airman at a nuclear missile site.
